title: Higher-order sum rules for zeros of the planar Gaussian entire function
summary: We establish marginal sum rules for the truncated correlation functions of zeros of the planar Gaussian entire function (GEF). For each fixed integer $k\ge2$, the integral in one coordinate converges absolutely and equals $-(k-1)$ times the truncated correlation of order $k-1$. This answers the marginal-identity question posed by Krishnapur and Yogeshwaran for the planar GEF. We also prove a criterion for simple point processes under local moment and absolute integrability assumptions.
